email.body1:
Greg, saw PlanSource just unveiled its evolved brand after a year of AI-driven transformation and the UKG Innovator of the Year nod.

A repositioning like that opens more in-market employers than a sales team can personally cover, and that is where growth pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PlanSource off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit the growth number
email.body2:
Greg, quick follow-up for PlanSource.

A fresh brand usually raises growth expectations faster than headcount can keep up. Most growth leaders can't say precisely how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap surfaces late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PlanSource needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Greg, last bit of proof for PlanSource.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PlanSource's reply rate likely compares to similar benefits-tech companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to PlanSource's growth motion? I'll tailor it to your team either way.
